name: ngonorrhoeae_inhibition_rank
description: Rank score of how likely the compound is to inhibit the growth of Neisseria gonorrhoeae with a MIC at or below 8 micrograms per millilitre. Calibrated against 50K compounds from the Ersilia reference library so that a score of 0.65 is better than 99% of them. Recommended threshold: 0.65.
